Mohammed bin Rashid bin Mohammed honours the winners of the third edition of the Create Apps Championship at Emirates Towers Boulevard. The championship is part of the Create Apps in Dubai initiative, led by Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy to support app development, digital skills and technology entrepreneurship in the emirate. The third edition attracted 9,754 entries, bringing total participation across the three editions to 15,564 applications from 153 countries. Over its three editions, the championship has contributed to the development of 1,700 prototypes and supported the launch of more than 140 applications.
